summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a clinical milestone: 20 participants treated in its Phase I/IIa trial of CMND-100 for Alcohol Use Disorder. The filing is a routine operational update with no corporate event triggering a special situation. No deal terms are present. The press release details dosing progress and safety data but involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The content is purely operational, not a special situation.
